method: Signed-in admin UI media download, source pixel inspection, fresh page reload, full-screen open and independently inspected screenshot pixels.

source.description: Portrait QA graphic with peach circle, grid and release-check lettering.

conclusion: The stored source is intact and its portrait is rendered in the fresh full-screen screenshot. The earlier inference that the source itself was a dark image is superseded by measured source and screenshot evidence.
limits: The crop comparison allows JPEG and subpixel resampling differences; it is not a claim of byte-identical rendering.
No stored source file was modified during this investigation.
